PROJECT [col("id"), when((col("price") > lit(10))).then(lit("high")).otherwise(lit("low")).alias("band"), when(col("discount").is_not_null()).then(col("discount")).otherwise(lit(0)).alias("disc")]
  FILTER [col("id").is_in(lit(1), lit(3))]
    MEMORY SCAN 6 rows
      projection: [id, price, discount] (3/6 cols)
